name: easyscreenshot
description: easyscreenshot: give it a website and it picks the pages worth showing, saves clean desktop, phone and full-page screenshots your coding agent can use, and records a short demo video of the site.

plugins.name: easyscreenshot
plugins.description: Opens a product's website in a headless browser, picks the pages worth showing (home, pricing, features and the like), hides cookie banners and chat bubbles, and saves desktop, phone and full-page PNGs with manifest.json and SCREENSHOTS.md. It also records a short demo video of the site (MP4 and GIF), as a tour or from steps you write, and takes the screenshots a web app manifest needs.
